'''Kaz Tagan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was stationed in the [[Lucent Square]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where he served as a trainer.
